title: FuTransformer: FP8 prefill and INT4 decode for Llama-style inference on Hopper
abstract: arXiv:2610.23796v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformer prefill reuses weights across tokens and is dominated by matrix multiplication and activation data movement; single-token decode has limited reuse and is dominated by weight and KV-cache reads. We present FUTRANSFORMER, a CUDA implementation of a Llama-style Transformer block for NVIDIA Hopper GPUs. It applies CODA's GEMM-plus-epilogue approach to inference, adding direct KV-cache placement, folding the fixed RMSNorm gain into weights, writing FP8 output directly with delayed scaling, and supporting prefill without padding. Decode uses INT4 projection weights and an INT4 KV-cache copy. Weights and keys follow Tensor Core fragment layouts for direct dequantization into MMA operands without full intermediate tiles. A block-diagonal Hadamard transform reduces cache quantization error from outlier channels. On one H100, prefill is up to 1.48x faster than compiled PyTorch FP8 and reaches 1.29 PFLOP/s. translated_title: FuTransformer：面向Hopper架构Llama风格推理的FP8预填充与INT4解码
translated_abstract: Transformer的预填充阶段会在多个token之间复用权重，其性能主要受矩阵乘法和激活值数据搬运的支配；而单token解码阶段的复用有限，性能主要受权重和KV缓存读取的支配。我们提出了FUTRANSFORMER，这是一个针对NVIDIA Hopper GPU的Llama风格Transformer块的CUDA实现。该方法将CODA的GEMM加尾部融合方案应用于推理，引入了直接的KV缓存放置方式，将固定的RMSNorm增益折叠进权重中，通过延迟缩放直接写入FP8输出，并支持无需填充的预填充。解码阶段使用INT4投影权重和INT4 KV缓存副本。权重和键值遵循Tensor Core分片布局，可直接反量化为MMA操作数，无需生成完整的中间瓦片。块对角Hadamard变换降低了异常通道带来的缓存量化误差。在单个H100上，预填充速度比编译的PyTorch FP8快达1.48倍，达到1.29 PFLOP/s。对于门控/上投影……
tldr: 该论文提出FUTRANSFORMER，一个面向NVIDIA Hopper GPU的Llama风格推理CUDA实现，融合FP8预填充、INT4解码权重与KV缓存、直接KV缓存放置及块对角Hadamard变换等优化，在单张H100上预填充速度比编译的PyTorch FP8快达1.48倍、达到1.29 PFLOP/s。
en_tdlr: FuTransformer is a CUDA implementation of Llama-style inference on NVIDIA Hopper GPUs that integrates FP8 prefill with fused GEMM epilogues, INT4 decode weights and KV-cache, and a block-diagonal Hadamard transform, achieving up to 1.48x prefill speedup over compiled PyTorch FP8 and 1.29 PFLOP/s on a single H100.
